correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the printed susceptible Ito equation. Under hypothetical convergence to the positive deterministic disease-free point, Itô’s formula for the logarithm of the susceptible coordinate gives an asymptotic drift equal to negative one-half the squared susceptible noise amplitude, while Brownian motion divided by time vanishes almost surely; this contradicts the logarithm of the susceptible coordinate divided by time tending to zero. On the disease-free invariant face, direct solution of the zero-current Fokker–Planck equation gives the normalized inverse-gamma density. Exact rational arithmetic verifies the reported parameter moments.

value.rationale: The distinction changes the interpretation of stochastic extinction: infection can vanish while susceptible uncertainty remains intrinsically nondegenerate. The exact boundary law quantifies that uncertainty and, at the source’s own parameters, has variance \(2025/79\), so the correction is not a tiny numerical effect.
